production.note: US model years 2004-2009. First: the 2.2-litre engine arrived with the 2004 model ('Larger displacement 2.2-liter engine (+0.2 liters)'). Last: "The 2009 Honda S2000 will be the final model year produced of the award-winning roadster" (honda-s2000-final-2009). The S2000 CR (2008-2009) is a separate record.

aspiration.note: Inferred: 'Multi-Point Programmed Fuel Injection (PGM-FI)', 11.1:1 compression; no turbocharger or supercharger is listed.

transmission.note: 'revised 6-speed, manual transmission'; the 2006 sheet lists '6-Speed w/Torque-Sensing Limited-Slip Differential'. Manual only.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower (SAE net @rpm) | 237@7800". Reference year 2006: Honda rated the same engine 240 hp @ 7,800 rpm for 2004 and 2005 (honda-s2000-2004-release: "240 horsepower @ 7800 rpm") and restated it as 237 hp from the 2006 model under the revised SAE net procedure (honda-s2000-summary-2006: "SAE net rev. 8/04 update: 2.2-liter VTEC 4-cylinder engine (237 horsepower @ 7800"). 237 hp is the rating for four of the six model years, so it is used.

weightLb.note: Single configuration (manual roadster), 2006 model. Quote: "Curb Weight (lbs.) | 2855". The 2004 model was 2,835 lb per Honda's 2004 release ("Weight (lbs.): 2835").

sources.title: Honda S2000 Receives Enhanced Power and Improved Handling for 2004
2009 Will Be Final Model Year of Production for Honda S2000

discrepancies.reason: Model year and rating procedure. Honda rated the 2.2-litre engine 240 hp for 2004-2005 and 237 hp from 2006, when it re-rated under the revised SAE net procedure ('SAE net rev. 8/04').
discrepancies.resolution: Used 237 hp: the reference model year is 2006 and that rating covers most of the run (2006-2009).

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Honda gives 2,835 lb for the 2004 model and 2,855 lb on the 2006 sheet (drive-by-wire throttle and Vehicle Stability Assist added for 2006).
discrepancies.resolution: Used 2,855 lb because the reference model year is 2006.
